read_scope: Original Brunner and Munzel paper (2000), publisher abstract/metadata read
mapping_rationale: Nonparametric Behrens-Fisher relative-effect test with ties matches the variant's estimand.
cautions: Full article and exact finite-sample conditions not reviewed; neither small-sample approximation nor a numerical n floor establishes universal validity.

read_scope: Official SciPy barnard_exact API documentation read
mapping_rationale: Pooled Wald statistic with unconditional nuisance-probability maximization is the same method family.
cautions: Python API is not the R teaching template; optimizer, tolerance and discrete ordering implementation differ. Use conceptual reference, not an independent numerical oracle or exact CTTIR tutorial.

read_scope: Jonckheere (1954), publisher metadata read; article access restricted
mapping_rationale: Original ordered k-sample alternative matches the predeclared group order.
cautions: Full mathematical content not read. Tie correction, directional convention and permutation workflow still require a dedicated lesson/review.

mapping_rationale: Proportion trend with supplied group scores matches the test family.
cautions: Core documentation is a chi-square trend test; the variant's signed statistic and directional alternatives are additional behavior, not taught by this page.

mapping_rationale: Median-centered absolute deviations and F statistic match the median variant.
cautions: Page frames equal-variance testing as a prerequisite for ANOVA. Do not import that automatic pretest routing into inferguidR; use formula-specific context only.

mapping_rationale: Normal-population variance ratio test and interval match stats::var.test in the teaching template.
cautions: Normality, group ordering, independent sampling and strict input guards remain essential. API documentation does not validate every data design.

mapping_rationale: Median-centered normal-score rank procedure matches stats::fligner.test.
cautions: Robustness discussion is not an exact finite-sample guarantee; asymptotic approximation and interpretation need lesson context.

mapping_rationale: Explains the classical variance-versus-fixed-target chi-square statistic as background.
cautions: Variant is deliberately rejected-only with no executable template. This page does not establish support; its visible text also does not state the normal-population premise prominently, so it is insufficient as a standalone guide.
existing_cttir_assessment: Keep unavailable for execution; optional background reference only.

read_scope: Fagerland, Lydersen and Laake (2013), publisher full text read
mapping_rationale: Directly studies matched-binary McNemar mid-p and distinguishes it from exact conditional testing.
cautions: Mid-p does not guarantee nominal-level control. Template's exact conditional discordant-pair odds interval is not an inversion of the mid-p test; retain that distinction.
existing_cttir_assessment: Existing CTTIR McNemar tutorial teaches asymptotic/exact, not mid-p, and has documented output discrepancies; do not reuse as an exact match.

read_scope: Stuart (1955), publisher metadata read; article access restricted
mapping_rationale: Original marginal-homogeneity paper matches the intended null.
cautions: Full content not read. Reject unqualified substitution of DescTools StuartMaxwellTest page: its Details states pairwise symmetry p_ij=p_ji although the Description says marginal homogeneity; its category-dropping policy also differs from the strict template.

mapping_rationale: For square tables the documented null equates opposite off-diagonal probabilities; this is symmetry, not marginal homogeneity.
cautions: Continuity correction applies only to 2x2. Core vector API removes incomplete cases whereas the template uses explicit stricter input handling; sparse-table limitations remain.

mapping_rationale: Complete binary repeated blocks and the approximate chi-square statistic match the test family.
cautions: Automatic removal of incomplete blocks in that API is not the strict template's policy. Treat this as related package documentation, not an interchangeable execution recipe.

mapping_rationale: Binomial random-intercept GLMM with conditional mean and adaptive quadrature matches the implementation family.
cautions: Generic glmer docs do not teach all variant guardrails, quadrature sensitivity comparisons or inferguidR output conventions. Conditional effects must remain distinct from marginal GEE effects.

read_scope: Official JSS article abstract and author-maintained geepack vignette read
mapping_rationale: Marginal generalized linear models for clustered binary data match the GEE estimand.
cautions: Cluster ordering, sufficient independent clusters, exchangeable working correlation and robust inference require lesson detail. Publisher landing date is Dec 2005 while package citation/vignette uses 2006; do not infer a new bibliography year without disambiguation.

mapping_rationale: Maximum-likelihood common-factor analysis and rotations match the core estimator.
cautions: The page does not teach the entire SMC/permutation parallel-analysis count-selection workflow or establish latent causal interpretation.

mapping_rationale: SVD-based centered/scaled principal components match the template.
cautions: Component sign arbitrariness and scaling matter; PCA is not a common-factor model, and the page does not validate a scientific dimension-selection rule.

mapping_rationale: Ward.D2 clustering and its handling of dissimilarities match the chosen core algorithm.
cautions: Ward.D and Ward.D2 are not interchangeable. The template's scaling, k choice and subsampling stability workflow need additional explanation; clusters are not confirmatory categories.

mapping_rationale: Hartigan-Wong k-means, multiple starts and convergence diagnostics match the core algorithm.
cautions: Local minima, arbitrary label numbers, scaling and stability remain separate issues. This does not document the whole 80-percent subsample ARI workflow.

read_scope: Official cluster daisy and pam documentation read
mapping_rationale: Type-aware Gower dissimilarity plus medoid clustering matches the two-stage template.
cautions: Explicit variable types, asymmetric-binary zero handling and pairwise missing information matter. Pairwise policy is opt-in in the template; these API pages do not establish k or stability interpretation.
